title: Residents protest Metro 11 office on Bandra plot reserved for garden

ai.summary: Residents in Bandra protest the allocation of a garden plot to Metro Line 11 office, demanding restoration of recreational space after years of unfulfilled promises.

facts.claim: Residents protest the allocation of a garden plot to Metro Line 11 office
facts.quote: Residents plan to assemble at the plot on Sunday, to protest the allotment and demand their recreational ground.

facts.claim: The plot was designated as a recreational ground in the city’s Development Plan 2034
facts.quote: The plot, near Guru Nanak Hospital in Bandra (east), looks nothing like a recreational ground (RG) – and yet it is designated as one in the city’s Development Plan 2034.

facts.claim: Residents have waited over a decade for the promised open space
facts.quote: Arvind Sawant, former senior police inspector with the Mumbai Crime Branch and chairperson of Renuka Cooperative Housing Society, underlined that they had waited more than a decade for the promised open space.

facts.claim: The plot was used for Metro Line 3 site office for 11 years
facts.quote: Under the jurisdiction of the suburban district collector, the plot hosted the site office of Metro Line 3 for 11 years.

facts.claim: The plot is 3,500-sq m and will accommodate 15 department heads
facts.quote: Construction work is underway on a 3,500-sq m plot in Bandra (East). Six pits, each 4 feet deep, have been dug for the foundation of a site office for Metro Line 11. The site office will accommodate the cabins of 15 department heads of the Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (MMRCL).

ai.background_note: Residents in Bandra have been waiting over a decade for a promised recreational space after the plot was used for Metro Line 3 site office for 11 years, but now it is being allocated to Metro Line 11 office for five years.
